MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 19
   D. 23

2. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

4. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 8
   D. 9

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 1

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
